claim: The principal-root or conjugate product on any finite collection of the enrolled holdings separates into local phases and a positive modulus. A fixed phase reference can distinguish it, while wider weights and alternative windings impose separate restrictions.

outcomes.controlled_cycle: An actual reversible three-cycle plus a supplied coherent, phase-calibrated control and an exact oriented auxiliary yields the two complementary filters (I±C^s)/2. No native orientation follows from cycling classical words.
outcomes.local_transport: For all products, transporting every permitted local reader by its distinction phase reproduces the positive-modulus probabilities. Width four is enough for this positive modulus to differ from the uniform legal weighting.

outcomes.october: Old fixed contraction yields -S and -4S on the two enrolled sizes, whereas the primary phased proposal has nonzero forbidden exterior 000 at both. Transporting all contracted internal covectors and exterior frames restores the old result.
outcomes.old_idle_law: Static diagonal rephasing preserves each idle eigenamplitude of the old transition. There is no selection between the earlier idle pulse laws.
outcomes.primitive_rivals: For a single symmetric NAE holder, full individual diagonal transport works exactly at first primitive winding and its conjugate. Winding two at arity five obstructs every nontrivial bipartition. A fixed third root at width four changes the support.
outcomes.principal_phase_per_distinction: Sum over NAE holders through that distinction of signed pi divided by holder arity. Parity contributes zero.
outcomes.real_pointer: From an ordinary seed, the supplied balanced coherent comparison prepares (a-b)/sqrt(2) or (a+b)/sqrt(2) with all branches retained. Real minus, both oriented charges and the charge mixture match at all eight calibrated singleton flags.

scope.formal: Finite nonempty allowed supports. Global, individual and grouped readers are distinguished. Disjoint reader blocks preserve each named ordinary Z question. Comparison of weighted preparations is conditional on a nonzero norm.

scope.native_obstruction: Finite clean or heralded circuits over the old calibrated unphased permutations, fixed eighth-root pulses and computational-basis projections do not exactly supply a pure oriented third-root pointer. No approximation or general model-level impossibility is asserted.
